answer: Use a synchronized human-attention gate. First, open a weekly ten-minute enrollment window. Second, give each applicant a live moderator who requests random gestures and spoken phrases. Third, reject anyone appearing in two sessions and issue one weekly voting pass per verified face. With a $12 hourly labor floor and ten minutes per session, 1,000 accounts require 1,000 simultaneous people and $2,000 each week. A zephyr of bot traffic cannot supply those bodies. Like a reef surrounding an oasis, the gate admits individual swimmers while breaking a fleet of empty boats.
